svg.font-family: Plex, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.title: The steps of a systematic review in ReviewDesk
svg.desc: 19 steps in 7 phases: Plan (steps 1 to 2); Search (steps 3 to 5); Screen titles and abstracts (steps 6 to 10); Full texts (steps 11 to 13); Extract and appraise (steps 14 to 16); Synthesise and rate certainty (steps 17 to 18); Report (step 19). At step 9, the agreement rule decides whether one reviewer or both screen the rest.

rest, with the AI second screener behind them.
